key_findings: UVB irradiation (2 min protocol optimal) attenuated lumbar instability-induced disc degeneration and pain behavior in mice.
UVB restored NRF2/HO-1, lowered KEAP1, and suppressed NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1, GSDMD and IL-1β/IL-18; causality between NRF2 and pyroptosis was not directly tested.
